title: Allocated-byte leak hunt and rollback path for KV slab accounting drift
creator: Maya Chen
description: During a multi-day capacity event in production we observed steady growth in resident memory on a subset of inference nodes running the prefix/KV cache. Heap and slab usage metrics diverged from expected live entry counts: allocated_bytes increased while live_entry_count remained stable. This ticket tracks the investigation (root cause hypothesis), temporary mitigations, and a safe rollback/patch rollout path to remediate the accounting drift and prevent recurrence.
impact_summary: Gradual memory growth on dedicated runtime nodes caused autoscaler thrashing and a handful of node restarts. User-facing latency spikes were intermittent; no model outputs were corrupted. Estimated affected capacity: ~2% of Dedicated fleet for 48 hours, causing a capacity shortfall for high-throughput tenants and increased cost due to autoscaling overprovisioning.

root_cause_summary: A narrow race in slab compaction + reservation accounting left orphaned allocation records when compaction encountered a concurrent eviction path. Specifically, a compaction fast-path reused slab slots and advanced the per-shard allocation epoch without atomically reconciling reservation counters. The result was an allocated_bytes counter that counted freed-but-not-reconciled bytes, causing monotonic growth of the metric and retention of internal metadata until a restart or explicit sweep freed the orphaned bookkeeping entries.
technical_details: Compaction flow reused 'slot_id' from a reclaimed bucket while a concurrent eviction worker was promoting tombstones; due to a missing memory_barrier and non-atomic decrement of reservation_counter an orphaned metadata node remained referenced from the allocation_index but not in the live_entry_set

Per-tenant reservation soft caps allowed allocation to exceed pressure thresholds when prefetch bursts occurred; the allocator compensated by deferring reconciliation which amplified the accounting drift
Observed failure mode reproducible in a high-concurrency stress harness using prefetch=24, eviction_backoff=0ms, and compaction_concurrency=4
Heap profiler showed thin stacks holding onto small descriptor objects (~48–256 bytes each) that were never reachable from canonical entry maps but still accounted in allocated_bytes metric
mitigation_work_done: Reduced prefetch concurrency from 24 -> 8 across affected pools (config flag: kv.prefetch.max_concurrency)
Increased eviction aggressiveness: eviction_score_decay shortened and eviction_scan_window widened for a temporary period
Deployed targeted restart+drain of 32 suspect nodes to reclaim orphaned metadata
Added a staging-only sweeper that scanned slab allocation_index for zero-ref metadata and reclaimed entries; used to validate fixed behavior before production sweep
Instrumented new metrics: slab_orphan_count, allocation_epoch_lag, reservation_overcommit_ratio, compaction_retries_total
remaining_action_items: (A1) Ship allocator atomicity fix: ensure reservation_counter updates and epoch advances are performed under the allocator lock or via CAS with a retry loop (owner: Rafael Ortiz, estimate 5)
(A2) Implement background progressive sweeper in runtime with exponential backoff to heal orphaned descriptors without impacting tail latency (owner: Priya Nair, estimate 3)

(A3) Add automatic rollback guard: cluster-toggle 'kv.allocated_bytes_threshold_kill' to disable prefetch and force synchronous eviction if allocated_bytes grows > X% in 10m (owner: Infra Ops, estimate 2)
(A4) Add unit + fuzz tests around compaction + eviction interleaving; include deterministic scheduler scenarios (owner: QA Eng, estimate 5)
(A5) Update runbook and postmortem doc with 'how to identify' via new metrics and escalation steps (owner: Maya Chen, estimate 2)
(A6) Long-term: evaluate per-tenant memory ceilings and allocation quotas to avoid cross-tenant amplification (owner: Product - Khurram Iqbal, estimate 3)
(A7) Release: include migration tool to run an offline sweep for older clusters that didn't receive the fix before March 2026 (owner: Rafael Ortiz, estimate 4)
(A8) Backfill dashboards and create composite alert 'kv-slab-accounting-drift' tied to allocation_epoch_lag and slab_orphan_count (owner: Observability, estimate 2)
(A9) Run a canary rollout plan and schedule a 24-hour watch after 10% rollout (owner: Release Eng, estimate 1)
(A10) Customer outreach: notify top 10 high-throughput tenants about potential disruptions and provide remediation checklist (owner: CSM, estimate 1)
(A11) Security review: confirm sweeper and allocator changes have no data-exfil risk (security_review_required)
(A12) Post-release chaos test: inject compaction/ejection races in pre-prod via chaos harness for 3 weeks
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Canary): apply allocator atomicity patch + sweeper disabled to 1% of Dedicated nodes (canary pool) for 48h; monitor slab_orphan_count and allocation_epoch_lag
Phase 1 (Conservative): enable background sweeper at low rate and deploy to 10% of Dedicated fleet; keep prefetch concurrency at reduced settings; 24h watch with SRE
Phase 2 (Gradual): full rollout to Dedicated, then Hosted API nodes over 72h with rolling drains and restart where needed

Rollback: flip 'kv.alloc-accounting-fix-enabled' to false and enable kill-switch 'kv.allocated_bytes_threshold_kill' to trigger aggressive eviction and synchronous reconciliation. Run emergency sweep script if rollback triggered.
Post: schedule a follow-up retrospective 2 weeks after full rollout
monitoring_and_alerting: Create alert 'kv-alloc-drift-warning' when allocation_epoch_lag > 1 for > 10m in >= 5 nodes
Create critical alert 'kv-slab-orphan-spike' when slab_orphan_count grows by 100% within 30m in any shard group
Dashboard: add 'Slab integrity' dashboard with time-series: allocated_bytes_gauge, live_entry_count, slab_orphan_count, allocation_epoch_lag, reservation_overcommit_ratio
Add runbook entries describing thresholds and immediate mitigations (reduce prefetch, increase eviction aggressiveness, node drain)
testing_and_validation: Unit tests for allocator CAS loop and epoch advance edge cases
Deterministic scheduler integration test: compaction vs eviction interleavings simulated with concurrency=8
Staging ramp: run 48h soak tests on staging with prefetch=24 and compaction_concurrency=4 to ensure no drift
Fuzz harness to inject delayed frees and validate sweeper reclaims within expected time window
